tagline: The open source AI coding agent, in your browser
description:
OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent. This package runs
OpenCode 2.2.3 as a web app (opencode web) so you can use it from
your browser on your ZimaOS box, with your projects mounted at
/workspace.

Set OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD when installing. Without it the web
UI is unsecured, and anyone who can reach it can run commands in
the container with access to your workspace.
author: restuindrawan

tips.before_install:
Set OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD during install. OpenCode can run
shell commands and edit files in /workspace, so an unsecured
web UI is remote code execution for anyone who can reach it.
Use it without a password only on a trusted LAN, and prefer a
VPN or HTTPS reverse proxy over publishing it to the internet.

Your provider API keys and sessions are stored in the data
folder (/root/.local/share/opencode, including auth.json).
Keep that folder private. Adjust the /workspace path during
install to point at the projects you want OpenCode to work on.

Note: the upstream image is minimal (OpenCode and ripgrep, no
git or language toolchains), so tasks that need those tools
inside the container will be limited.

title: OpenCode
release_note: Initial release. OpenCode 2.2.3 web UI on port 4096, with optional OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD basic auth (empty by default).
